about_short_description.short_description: Parenthoods is a community platform for local parents to meet up, share advice, and help each other.

product.name: Community Platform
product.description: A digital space for parents to connect, share advice, and support each other.

product.name: For You Tab
product.description: A personalized feed combining posts from favorite users and subscribed topics.

product.name: Activities and Meet-Ups
product.description: Features for organizing and participating in local parent meet-ups and activities.

product.name: Classifieds Section
product.description: A marketplace for buying and selling parenting gear among community members.

product.name: Remote/Virtual Activities Support
product.description: Enables participation in activities and meet-ups virtually, accommodating different time zones.

product.name: Anonymous Posting
product.description: Allows users to comment anonymously on posts for privacy.
